name: Message Reference 1
definition: Business reference(s) to one or more relevant messages previously sent by other parties, or by the same party issuing this message.

Reference.name: Reference
Reference.definition: Unambiguous reference to a previous message having a business relevance with this message.

MessageName.name: Message Name
MessageName.definition: Name of the message which contained the given additional reference as its message reference.

ReferenceIssuer.name: Reference Issuer
ReferenceIssuer.definition: Party that initially assigned the given additional reference.
